scope: Pair the approved Shell contrast changes with the published Tahoe release while preserving Golden Gate defaults.
environment: Local wrapper checks and prepared edition source. Shared renderer qualification in a disposable KDE neon Wayland VM.

approval.message: si pero muestrame unas 10 capturas de muchas configuraciones, talvez 20, on y off

checks.command: python3 -m pytest -q <focused checksum, fallback, staging and release-workflow checks>
Validate immutable Tahoe codeload archive, version, component ledger and installed QML hashes

checks.detail: Staged version, wallpaper, launcher preset, component ledger and the two changed QML payload files verified.

coverage_limits: Single representative Wayland VM. The incremental QML styling does not change the installer lifecycle, X11 backend, or native KWin interfaces.
The substitute and default wallpapers are representative fixtures; the numeric sample covers the capsule over the Tahoe default light wallpaper.

A Plasma service stop with exported Kate menus can trigger an AppMenuModel teardown crash in both the prior implementation and the candidate. The contrast change does not touch that model. The affected disposable session was recovered before further captures.
Existing documentation galleries keep their original provenance. Full CI runs independently.
